overview_description.description:
YouTeam is developing a new standard in outsourcing by giving businesses access to a global talent pool from multiple outsourcing agencies. The marketplace model outperforms the single-agency model in all aspects, offering more candidates, faster sourcing, filtering and comparison options, automated contracting and billing, and independent support.

Used by:
250+ tech companies across the US, UK, and Europe.
50+ Y Combinator startups.
3 Fortune 500 companies.

about_short_description.short_description: YouTeam is a new, smarter way to outsource. Your single point of access to 500+ vetted agencies, 50,000+ contractors.

product.name: YouTeam Talent Marketplace
product.description: A platform providing access to a vetted pool of over 50,000 software engineers from 500+ development agencies for remote staff augmentation.

product.name: YouTeam Matching Process
product.description: A personalized matching service that uses AI and human experts to shortlist vetted software engineers aligned with client requirements within days.

product.name: Standardized Contracting and Payment Services
product.description: A service offering standardized contracts, automated payroll, currency conversion, and payment handling for remote engineering engagements.

product.name: YouTeam Partner Network
product.description: A curated network of over 500 vetted software development agencies from Latin America and Europe eligible to provide remote engineering talent.
